role: Read-only primary-source research; no builds downloaded or executed by this researcher.
sourceMethod: Browsed developer repositories/releases, then read fresh official GitHub expanded_assets HTML and raw README/catalogue JSON. GitHub API returned 403 rate limit. Cached web sidebar for Anarch360 was stale; fresh release HTML confirms v1.0.0.
generalLimits: Do not infer any exact minimum dashboard/kernel from unsigned-XEX support. These developers generally do not publish one.

RGH/JTAG is explicitly required in the xenosworks release notes and Harissa documentation. Balatro360 explicitly also names ABadAvatar. CTR360 describes unsigned XEX support without asserting a specific exploit.
Inherited upstream README files for Starship, Dusklight and SwanStation describe other platforms. Use the Xbox360 fork release notes for these exact builds.
Approximate sizes below came from GitHub rendered asset lists. Only marked exactBytes values were confirmed with HTTP HEAD; archival intake must compute final byte counts and SHA-256.
Manual and store ZIPs are distinct ready-build assets; keep their names and hashes separate. The store catalogue has exact per-file XEX hashes that can verify the generic packages.

catalogue.artworkCredit: Xbox360 screenshots published by xenosworks in the Homebrew App Catalogue; port authors and original game creators retain their respective work.
catalogue.artworkEvidence: Catalogue README specifies screenshots of the app itself on console, PNG/JPEG 1280x720.

entries.name: Starship for Xbox 360
entries.requires: RGH/JTAG; own US Star Fox 64 ROM revision 1.0 or 1.1, .z64/.n64/.v64.
entries.install: Copy apps/starship to Hdd1:/apps/starship; put ROM beside starship.xex and start it. First run makes sf64.o2r and deletes supplied ROM. Existing sf64.o2r from Xbox360 0.1.0.0 or PC Starship2.0.0 also works.
entries.storage: Settings, saves and starship.log stay beside XEX. Keep frame interpolation at default30; developer reports scene-build stalls.

entries.name: Dusklight for Xbox 360
entries.requires: RGH/JTAG; own US GameCube Twilight Princess GZ2E01 as full uncompressed ISO named dusklight.iso, exactly1459978240 bytes; compressed or trimmed images unsupported.
entries.install: Copy apps/dusklight including res to Hdd1:/apps/dusklight; put dusklight.iso beside dusklight.xex. It closes immediately without disc.
entries.storage: Preserve TwilitRealm/Dusklight in app folder for saves/settings/shader cache. Leave Unlock Framerate off; shader pop-in is a documented issue.

entries.name: SwanStation for Xbox 360
entries.requires: RGH/JTAG; own PlayStation BIOS such as SCPH1001.BIN and owned disc images.
entries.install: Hdd1:/apps/swanstation/swanstation.xex with BIOS beside it; images in apps/swanstation/games or USB games folder. Supports CUE+BIN,CHD,M3U,PBP,ISO,ECM,MDS,BIN.
entries.storage: Per-game memory cards in apps/swanstation/saves. Wait a few seconds after in-game save before quitting. 0.1.1.0 fixes prior memory-card loss; keep BIOS and games when updating.

entries.name: Balatro360
entries.requires: README explicitly supports RGH or ABadAvatar; own Steam PC Balatro.exe, or Balatro.love from inside Mac Balatro.app; about150MB free.
entries.install: Copy apps/balatro360 to Hdd1 root, or folder anywhere on USB; put game executable beside default.xex. First run extracts game files and deletes supplied Balatro.exe.
entries.storage: Saves in balatro360/save with PC-compatible profile folders. Back+Start held one second exits. Real console required by author; Xenia unsupported.

entries.name: CTR360
entries.requires: Console that launches unsigned XEX, compatible dashboard such as Aurora, writable HDD/USB. Own NTSC-U SCUS-94426 disc BIN with2352-byte sectors and data track at byte0. Other regions/compressed images/extracted ISO unsupported.
entries.install: Put own BIN and CUE beside apps/ctr360/default.xex; allow610MB extra free. First launch makes assets/ctr-u.bin then deletes BIN/CUE; optional PC converter in manual ZIP.
entries.storage: Preserve memcards and ctr360.ini when updating. Back+Start exits. Catalogue's old needs sentence mentions PC converter; current README explicitly supports console conversion with this release.

entries.name: Homebrew App Store
entries.staleCatalogueStatus: 404 confirmed by parent archive intake; use actual manual ZIP listed by live expanded_assets HTML.
entries.requires: Unsigned-code console with writable HDD for hdd:/apps/<id>; network needed to obtain catalogue/downloads. No exact minimum kernel version stated.
entries.install: Keep cacert.pem beside homebrew_app_store.xex. Store installs apps under hdd:/apps/<id>. HTTPS catalogue signature and package/per-file SHA-256 are verified by app.

entries.name: Harissa64
entries.requires: RGH/JTAG Xbox360, controller and dashboard such as Aurora/FSD; own N64 games .z64/.n64/.v64/.zip. Most library remains untested by developer.
entries.install: Copy Harissa64 folder with default.xex to Hdd1:/Emulators/Harissa64; roms folder beside XEX. Files browser supports Hdd1,Usb0-2,Dvd; Y selects game folder.
entries.storage: Saves and states in saves/<game name> <code>; art/games caches artwork. Release contains art cover/background for Aurora asset manager.
entries.artwork: Use cover/background from release art folder after inspection; source README confirms these are Aurora artwork.

entries.name: HarissaDC
entries.requires: RGH/JTAG with Aurora/FSD/XeXMenu and owned Dreamcast dumps. No BIOS needed.
entries.install: Copy HarissaDC folder to Hdd:/Emulators/HarissaDC; games in games and launch default.xex. GDI+tracks,Redump GD-ROM CUE/BIN,CHDv5,ISO(data track only),7z(one game) supported.
entries.storage: config settings,saves states/VMU,art box art,cache extracted7z,harissadc.log. Known graphical glitches/slow cutscenes; CHD loading slower than GDI/CUE.

entries.name: Anarch360
entries.requires: README: hacked Xbox360 with Aurora, or Xenia. No exact minimum dashboard/kernel stated; do not infer temporary-exploit certification.
entries.install: Self-contained public-domain Doom-style game. Load anarch360.xex from a folder in the homebrew launcher. Original project says content is embedded/no external game assets needed.
entries.releaseNotes: First public release with graphics,sound,rumble,input; asset date2026-03-22.
entries.artworkCredit: Original Anarch game artwork by drummyfish, CC0, inherited in Fhoughton's Xbox360 port source. Label as Anarch game artwork; screenshot is not claimed to be captured on Xbox360.
